Borrowing its name from Duffel, a town in Flanders, Belgium, the humble duffel bag (sometimes styled as “duffle”) is one of the most enduring carry-all packs, beloved around the world.

Welcome to Shop Smarter: A series dedicated to highlighting not just what’s on sale, but why it’s worth owning. Discover more here.

Some might say the king of this style is the Patagonia Black Hole. But there are numerous alternatives out there, as well.

For instance, the REI Co-op Roadtripper 40 Duffel made our list of the best adventure duffels of 2025. And it just hit its lowest price ever.

Weekend warrior

Like other duffels, the Roadtripper has a generous capacity, capable of storing up to 40 liters of gear within its Oxford polyester form. And while the bulk of that is confined to the main compartment, it also has a zippered exterior pouch for quick-access small storage.

But that’s not all. The bag also comes with a pair of suitcase-style straps and a removable shoulder strap for dual carrying options. It also has grab handles on either side, making it easy to access in an overhead compartment.

Furthermore, the outside gets a DWR water-resistant treatment, helping to improve its weatherproofing, which will keep its contents safer, especially during travel.

And best of all, the whole bag can collapse down tiny for easier storage when you’re not using it, making it an exceptional auxiliary travel option.

Pricing and availability

Here’s the catch: only one colorway of the REI Co-op Roadtripper 40 Duffel is on sale. But if you’re keen on the Leaf Haven Midnight Navy style, it can be yours for just $30 (half of its $60 MSRP).
